title: Selected Products
fields_definition:
subtitle:
    label: Subtitle
    type: text
    span: left
    default: "Shop"

title:
    label: Title
    type: text
    span: right
    default: "Featured Products"

description:
    label: Description
    type: richeditor
    size: small

source:
    label: Product source
    type: dropdown
    span: left
    default: latest
    translatable: false
    options:
        manual: Manual selection
        latest: Latest products
        best_selling: Best sellers
        tagged: Tagged products

layout:
    label: Layout
    type: dropdown
    span: right
    default: grid
    translatable: false
    options:
        list: List
        grid: Grid
        slider: Slider

products:
    label: Products
    type: taglist
    mode: array
    useKey: true
    customTags: false
    translatable: false
    options: AmoriumCms\Shop\Classes\SectionProducts::productOptions
    placeholder: Select products
    comment: The selected products are shown in this order. Products without a price on the site are left out.
    trigger:
        action: show
        field: source
        condition: value[manual]

tag:
    label: Tag
    type: dropdown
    span: left
    translatable: false
    options: AmoriumCms\Shop\Classes\SectionProducts::tagOptions
    placeholder: Select a tag
    comment: Tags are given to products on the product page of the shop.
    trigger:
        action: show
        field: source
        condition: value[tagged]

limit:
    label: Maximum products
    type: number
    span: left
    min: 1
    max: 48
    default: 8
    translatable: false
    comment: Up to 48 products are shown.
    trigger:
        action: show
        field: source
        condition: value[latest][best_selling][tagged]
